coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
Preparing and eating breakfast, brewing tea with the kettle
Changing into work clothes and packing work bag and badge
Working a clinical shift as a health care professional, attending to patients and recording charts
Commuting home from the healthcare facility
Cooking and eating dinner, washing up dishes
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
Taking a hot shower after the water-heater evening peak ends
Running a load of laundry in the washing machine and drying clothes
Quiet leisure time on the computer and reading, using the desk lamp
